title: Bandanas or Scarves for Pets and their Humans- 50% proceeds donated
description:
Add a pop of charm to your everyday adventures with our versatile Crochet-Style Knit Bandanas! Thoughtfully designed for pets and their favorite humans, these cozy pieces can be worn by your pup, by you, or as a matching pair for the ultimate style statement.

Whether you’re heading out for a stroll, snapping cute photos, or looking for the perfect gift for a dog lover, this matching set is sure to turn heads!

✨ Why You & Your Pup Will Love It:
Versatile Style for Pets & Humans: Wear it as a neck bandana, a chic scarf, or a cute accessory. Buy a single bandana or choose the Matching Pair option to twin with your dog!

One Size Fits All Pets: Features extra-long tie strings that easily adjust to fit dogs of all sizes—from small pups to giant breeds.

Crochet-Style: Crafted in a beautiful crochet-style weave pattern available in multiple unique designs and colors.

Prints with a Purpose: 50% of proceeds from every sale are donated directly to local animal shelters to help animals in need! 🐾❤️

📏 Sizing & Fit Guidelines
For Pets: Simply wrap the bandana around your dog’s neck and secure it using the attached long tie strings. Adjust the tightness comfortably to suit short-haired or extra-fluffy pups alike.
For Humans: Can be worn as a stylish headband/hair accessory or like a neck bandana.

🧶 Care & Maintenance Instructions
Fabric Care: Hand wash or spot clean gently in cold water; lay flat to dry.
Pro-Tip: If your bandana arrives slightly rumpled or crushed from shipping, simply iron on low-to-medium heat to smooth it out instantly!

Thank you for supporting small businesses and helping us support shelter animals in need! 🐾

title: Handcrafted Wooden Bead Necklaces - Eco-Friendly, Multi-Themed, Various Sizes - 50% Proceeds Donated
description:
Bow- Bow Ties was founded by a 9 year old animal lover in 2021 with a mission to make the world a better place for animals. Since starting we have raised and donated over $4000. Support us to support more animals in need!

“Tabitha Beads” is a heartfelt collection of wooden bead accessories dedicated to a dog named Tabitha who had big feelings. Despite her sweet nature, training and hopeful spirit, Tabitha waited over 2 years for a forever home before tragically being euthanized. Her story moved us deeply, leading us to dedicate this new collection in her honor. Each piece in Tabitha Beads is not only a stunning accessory but also a symbol of hope and compassion. With every purchase, you're supporting long-stay dogs like Tabitha, providing them with the love, care and training they deserve. 50% of the sale proceeds will be donated to long-stay projects. Join us in honoring Tabitha's legacy and making a difference in the lives of animals in need.

You could use Tabitha Beads as human accessories as well for necklaces and bracelets. 

-Color and theme: Each piece showcases a harmonious blend of beautiful colors, whether they're blue ocean theme to yellow bumble bee theme, or red and green watermelon theme to black and white dog theme.
-Materials: Made from natural wooden beads, making them perfect for those who appreciate eco-friendly and sustainable fashion.
-Charms: Adorned with at least one special charm in each.
-Designs: Available in various sizes for dogs, cats, and humans. Use them as necklaces and/or bracelets. 
-Durable: Crafted to be sturdy and long-lasting.
-Adjustable: Features adjustable sizing for a comfortable fit for all sizes of dogs, cats and humans.
-Vibes: Whether you're strolling along the beach or having a picnic with your pet, these accessories will effortlessly complement your outfit and bring a touch of elegance to your look.
-Handcrafted: Crafted with precision and care, adding a unique and personal touch to every accessory.
-Vibes: The versatility of these bow ties makes them suitable for various occasions. Whether it's a charming photo session, birthday, gotcha day, festive holiday celebrations, themed parties, or even a casual everyday walk, your pet will be the epitome of style and charm and will stand out with panache.
- Gift Idea: Searching for a thoughtful present for a pet lover? Our fashionable bow ties are a delightful choice that adds not only a touch of charm to any pet's wardrobe but also spreads a symbol and story of compassion. Handmade with love, each purchase contributes to raising funds for animals in shelters.

How to Order:
1. Choose your preferred size and color/pattern from the dropdown menu.
2. Click “Add to Cart” and proceed to checkout.

Measuring Your Pet's Neck Size:
To ensure a perfect fit for your furry friend, follow these steps to measure their neck size accurately:
1. Use a soft measuring tape or a piece of string.
2. Gently wrap the measuring tape or string around the base of your dog or cat's neck, where their collar usually sits.
3. Make sure the tape or string is snug but not too tight.
4. Note down the measurement in inches, adding one extra inch.
5. Select the size when making your order.

Our  collection features an "Over the Head" design, allowing you to easily slide the accessory over your pet’s neck. 

-Packaging: We use recycled packaging to keep our cost low to ensure every dollar saved goes towards our donations. Also as a family we wholeheartedly support and practice recycling, reducing and reusing.
-Care Instructions: Worried about keeping them clean? Fret not! These bow ties are not only reusable but also washable. For best results, hand wash with cold water, ensuring that your pet's accessory stays fresh and vibrant.
-Safety Guidelines 
At Bow-Bow Ties we prioritize the safety of your beloved pets while adding style and flair to them. Please read and follow the safety guidelines:
 -    Always supervise your pet when they are wearing any accessory, to avoid any choking hazard.
 -    Remove the accessory during periods of rough play or activities that may pose a risk of entanglement.
 -    Discontinue use if your pet shows any signs of discomfort.
 -    In case of accidental ingestion or injury related to the accessory, seek veterinary assistance immediately.

Make a statement with your pet's style and make a difference in the lives of animals in need. Every purchase of our products contributes to creating a brighter future for shelter animals. Join us in the mission to add a touch of flair to your pet's wardrobe while making a meaningful impact on the lives of those who need it most.

title: Oven Baked All Natural Dog Treats - 7 oz. 50% donated.
description:
All-natural, oven-baked, homemade dog treats made in the USA that are full of flavors your dog will love and are made of wholesome ingredients you will approve of too. 

The mouthwatering recipes will keep your dog begging for more. Only the best ingredients are used for the health of your pet. The treats are baked to perfection, creating a crunchy treat that helps to keep your dog's teeth clean. 

Ingredients:

Peanut Butter: Rye flour, rolled oats, peanut butter, coconut oil, rosemary extract (Out of Stock) 

Apples & Cinnamon: Rye flour, rolled oats, apple, coconut oil, cinnamon, rosamary extract

Pumpkin: Rye flour, rolled oats, organic pumpkin, unsulphered cane molasses, coconut oil, turmeric, cinnamon, rosemary extract 

No corn, wheat, or soy.

And as always 50% donated for animals in need.
